newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy Btp spread over Bund falls to record low.
newsitem.headline: Italy Btp spread over Bund falls to record low.

text.p: The yield spread of the 10-year Btp over the benchmark 10-year Bund fell to a new record low of 165 basis points in early trade.
The last record low was set last Friday when the spread narrowed below 170 basis points to 168.
The July 2006 Btp was yielding 7.53 basis points at 0835 GMT while the 10-year Bund was yielding 5.87 basis points.
The July Btp was four basis points down on the day at 109.06.
